Carl Kurrick developed this course. >> Welcome to the course on discrete mathematics. On the beginning, let's say what is discrete mathematics? It is a field or as mentioned even a collection of fields that focuses on the study of structures and objects that can be counted meaning those that are equinian numerous with the set of natural numbers. In the other words 1 2 3 4 5 objects we can count them right even if there are infinity many. So we are concerned with things we can count like the number of swimming pools not with continuously varying quantities like the amount of water in each pool as it fills up which could be any positive real number.
